edits.before: At 6 you take the lane: bank two stacks with Q and W, then E-in (or Flash-R) and Slicing Maelstrom locks him in place while your storm stacks the third mark for the stun — and all of it is magic, so his crit-armor body doesn't save him. The catch is Remove Scurvy (W): it cleanses the slow and heals, so bait it out with an early Q before you commit the R all-in, or your stun-lock fizzles. Through levels 4-5 it's a chip-and-respect stretch — don't hard-commit without R up, just keep the poke lead.
edits.after: At 6 you take the lane: bank two stacks with Q and W, then E-in (or Flash-R) and Slicing Maelstrom locks him in place while your storm stacks the third mark for the stun — and all of it is magic, so his crit-armor body doesn't save him. Through levels 4-5 it's a chip-and-respect stretch — don't hard-commit without R up, just keep the poke lead.
